Description: Replacement of QtSingleApplication for Qt 6 Project SingleApplication is a replacement of QtSingleApplication for Qt 6. It helps to keep the primary instance of your application and kill each subsequent instances. If enabled, it can also spawn secondary (non-related to the primary) instances and send data to the primary instance from secondary instances. . This package provides the static library built in freestanding mode: the SingleApplication object is created separately after the Qt application object, so it works with QCoreApplication, QGuiApplication and QApplication alike. CMake users can call find_package(SingleApplication) and link against SingleApplication::SingleApplication.
